notes: Site is Shopify-hosted (nilkamalhomes.com), direct HTTP fetch worked, no robots.txt Claude-disallow. Enumerated all 629 store collections via /collections.json (3 pages, limit=250, 4th page confirmed empty/exhausted) and scanned every title/handle for Clearance target terms (clearance, outlet, final sale, last chance, end of line, discontinued) -- zero matches anywhere in the catalogue's collection taxonomy. Checked the homepage nav-linked '/pages/sale' page: it is a category-hub landing page (title 'Sale') that links only to standard permanent category collections (decor, furniture, kitchen, bath-laundry, etc.) with no product grid of its own (0 product-card markers, 0 'results/products found' text) -- not itself a PLP, and not clearance-flavored. Opened every sale/discount-worded collection found in the enumeration and grepped their raw HTML for clearance/outlet/final-sale/permanent-markdown language: 'big-sale' (Big Sale, 305 products), 'big-sale-furniture' (Big Sale (Furniture)), 'best-deals' (Best Deals, 1 product) plus its 6 category-specific 'best-deal-*' siblings, 'hot-offers' (H1 'Explore Big Sale Top Picks', 2 products), 'festive-collection' (H1 'Home Makeover Sale', 42 products), 'hot-offer-on-curated-top-picks' (0 products) -- none contain clearance/outlet/permanent-markdown wording; all read as generic temporary promotional 'sale/deal/offer' campaigns per the site's own labeling (Big Sale, Best Deals, Hot Offers, Home Makeover Sale), which the brief explicitly says must NOT be classified as Clearance absent a taxonomy signal of permanence. None were ambiguous enough to warrant a flagged row -- all lacked any clearance/outlet wording, unlike the brief's 'if uncertain, flag' case. Also tried the site's own search for 'clearance' (169 'results') and 'outlet' (754 'results') as a sanity check per the navigation-discovery rule; both returned unrelated products (random sofas/recliners) with no clearance-specific listing surfaced, confirming the search is non-discriminating (matches the known false-absence-test pattern for this class of Shopify search) and not usable as absence proof either way -- so the collections.json enumeration + content check above is the basis for this conclusion, not the search. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance/Outlet merchandising PLP exists on this site. No Claude-in-Chrome needed; tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficed throughout.
